_: The 16 Bold Cities. A city is a world (the old seed's geography: World = City -> Zones -> Places, and Lands), so each one is a Phiegg world with its zones, places, a post of its renders and a land plot (EGG) in every zone. Source: the shared drive folder BOLDCITIES-LANDTYPES (drive-map.json boldCities): NN-NAME/BC-NN (RENDERS), BCL-NN (marks), BLT-NN (the land). Land types and descriptions: BC-Land-Types-Phase-01. Zones and places: BOLD-CITY-README (Fashion, Entertainment and Social Districts). Run app/phiegg/scripts/bold-cities.py after editing; it never invents a picture.
names: A city's real name (from Downloads/@POSTS and the drive's logos) is its world's name; `land` is the land type it stands on. Forest, Desert, Swamp and City Ruins have no name yet, so they keep their land's.
layout: Every world's files: world/<slug>/mark.webp and world/<slug>/view/<view>-<width>.webp (served at worlds/<slug>/... in the bucket). The slug is the world's name; ids are w_<slug>, ct_<slug>_<zone>, s_<slug>, egg_<slug>_<zone>_land, all marked origin bold-cities. Source file and folder names from the drive are never used.

zones.name: Fashion District
zones.desc: The latest digital fashion: interactive shops and runway shows with avatars and models in BoldLooks.

places.name: Bold Shops
places.desc: Shops models walk into and out of with what they bought; a chatty doorman greets you.

places.name: Runway
places.desc: Bold collections on the walk, with the crowd seated on the sidelines.

zones.name: Entertainment District
zones.desc: Concerts, art installations and games with the Bold characters and visiting artists.

places.name: Concert Stage
places.desc: Concerts with musicians and the Bold characters.

places.name: Art Installations
places.desc: Installations and statues along the walkways.

places.name: Game Arcade
places.desc: Games with the Roids, Epics and Pups.

zones.name: Social District
zones.desc: Cafes, parks and plazas to meet, show your avatar and talk.

places.name: Cafe
places.desc: Tables on the square; the doorman knows your order.

places.name: Park
places.desc: Trees in tall pots, watered by the BoldRoids.

places.name: Plaza
places.desc: The square where everyone meets, under the ad screens.

land.name: Land · {zone}, {city}

post.caption: {city}: {desc} Every view of the city, from above to the close-ups.

cities.name: Forest

cities.name: Desert
cities.desc: An arid, sandy landscape of large, sweeping dunes.

cities.name: Peep City
cities.desc: Open fields and rolling hills with few large obstructions.

cities.name: Lace City

cities.name: Skim City
cities.desc: Deep blue water and the open sea, home of the ships and yachts.

cities.desc: Sandy shores, clear shallow water and coastal plants.

cities.name: Swamp

cities.name: Loon City
cities.desc: A wide, detailed world under the water.

cities.name: Lava City

cities.name: Wand City
cities.desc: Bright, reflective crystals, underground and in the open.

cities.name: Acro City
cities.desc: Land held high in the air, joined by bridges and platforms.

cities.name: Warp City
cities.desc: Moon-grey, cratered and quiet, with low gravity.

cities.name: Once City
cities.desc: Tall, contemporary buildings and sleek urban architecture.

cities.name: City Ruins

cities.name: Roid City
cities.desc: Dense streets, wet roads and bright neon signs.

cities.name: Bozo City
cities.desc: Low buildings around a town square, made for gathering.
